parse_document =: 3 : 0
    'document physical' =. y
    statements =. 0$a:
    diagnostics =. 0$a:
    section =. ''
    base =. ''
    assigned =. empty_table ''
    for_logical. logical_lines physical do.
        'line segments error' =. >logical
        if. #error do.
            'code message' =. error
            diagnostics =. diagnostics,<(<document),(<line),(<code),<message
            continue.
        end.
        segments =. trim_segments segments
        first =. 0{::segments
        if. (1=#segments) *. 0=#first do. continue. end.
        code =. message =. ''
        if. '['={.first do.
            'header parent colon' =. ':' cut_first }.}:first
            header =. trim_spaces header
            parent =. trim_spaces parent
            relative =. ('.'={.header) *. is_section_name }.header
            valid =. (1=#segments) *. ']'={:first
            valid =. valid *. (relative +. is_section_name header)
            if. colon do. valid =. valid *. is_section_name parent end.
            if. -.valid do.
                code =. 'E_SECTION'
                message =. 'invalid section header'
                section =. ''
            elseif. relative *. 0=#base do.
                code =. 'E_SECTION'
                message =. 'relative section without base'
                section =. ''
            else.
                if. relative do. section =. base,header
                else. section =. base =. header end.
                if. colon do.
                    statements =. statements,< (<'inherit'),(<line),(<section),<parent
                end.
            end.
        elseif. '@'={.first do.
            words =. (' ' split first)-.<''
            valid =. (1=#segments) *. 2=#words
            if. valid do.
                valid =. (({.words)e.'@include';'@unset') *. is_name 1{::words
            end.
            if. -.valid do. code =. 'E_SYNTAX' [ message =. 'invalid directive'
            elseif. '@include'-:0{::words do.
                statements =. statements,< (<'include'),(<line),(<1{::words),<''
            elseif. 0=#section do. code =. 'E_NO_SECTION' [ message =. 'no current section'
            else.
                statements =. statements,< (<'unset'),(<line),(<section,'.',1{::words),<''
            end.
        else.
            outside =. (I.0=2|i.#segments){segments
            equal =. +./'=' e.&> outside
            if. -.equal do. code =. 'E_SYNTAX' [ message =. 'invalid line'
            else.
                'key rest found' =. '=' cut_first first
                if. -.found do. code =. 'E_SYNTAX' [ message =. 'invalid key'
                else.
                    key =. trim_spaces key
                    append =. '+'={:key
                    if. append do. key =. rtrim }:key end.
                    if. -.is_name key do. code =. 'E_SYNTAX' [ message =. 'invalid key'
                    else.
                        parts =. trim_segments (<rest),}.segments
                        valid =. 1=#parts
                        value =. 0{::parts
                        if. 3=#parts do.
                            valid =. (0=#0{::parts) *. 0=#2{::parts
                            value =. 1{::parts
                        end.
                        if. -.valid do. code =. 'E_SYNTAX' [ message =. 'invalid value'
                        elseif. 0=#section do. code =. 'E_NO_SECTION' [ message =. 'no current section'
                        else.
                            full =. section,'.',key
                            if. -.append do.
                                if. full has_key assigned do.
                                    code =. 'W_DUPLICATE'
                                    message =. full,' already set at line ',number full get_key assigned
                                end.
                                assigned =. ((<full),<line) put_key assigned
                            end.
                            kind =. append{::'assign';'append'
                            statements =. statements,<(<kind),(<line),(<full),<value
                        end.
                    end.
                end.
            end.
        end.
        if. #code do. diagnostics =. diagnostics,<(<document),(<line),(<code),<message end.
    end.
    (<statements),<diagnostics
)

evaluate_reference =: 3 : 0
    key =. y
    definition =. key get_key ReferenceConfiguration
    text =. 0{::definition
    origin =. 1{::definition
    result =. ''
    position =. 0
    while. position<#text do.
        if. -. '${'-:2{.position}.text do.
            char =. position{text
            if. char=LITERAL_DOLLAR do. char =. '$' end.
            result =. result,char
            position =. position+1
            continue.
        end.
        tail =. (position+2)}.text
        close =. tail i.'}'
        reference =. close{.tail
        if. (close=#tail) +. -.is_section_name reference do.
            origin reference_report (<'E_BAD_REF'),<key,': invalid reference'
            (<0),<'' return.
        end.
        target =. reference
        if. -.'.'e.reference do. target =. (section_of key),'.',reference end.
        if. -.target has_key ReferenceConfiguration do.
            origin reference_report (<'E_UNDEFINED'),<key,': undefined reference ',target
            (<0),<'' return.
        end.
        if. (<target)e.ReferenceProgress do.
            path =. ((ReferenceProgress i.<target)}.ReferenceProgress),<target
            target_origin =. 1{::target get_key ReferenceConfiguration
            target_origin reference_report (<'E_CYCLE'),<'interpolation cycle ',' -> ' join path
            ReferenceCycles =: ~.ReferenceCycles,path
            expanded =. (<0),<''
        else.
            expanded =. expand_key target
        end.
        if. -.0{::expanded do.
            if. -.(<key)e.ReferenceCycles do.
                origin reference_report (<'E_DEPENDENCY'),<key,': depends on failed key ',target
            end.
            (<0),<'' return.
        end.
        result =. result,1{::expanded
        position =. position+close+3
    end.
    (<1),<result
)

logical_lines =: 3 : 0

parse_int =: 3 : 0

        success sign*16#.(Digits,'abcdef')i.hex

        parts =. '_' split text
        if. -.*./digits&>parts do. failure '' return. end.
        plain =. ;parts
        if. (#plain)>12 do. failure '' return. end.
        success sign*decimal plain

)

parse_size =: 3 : 0
    text =. y
    position =. 0
    while. position<#text do.
        if. -. (position{text)e.Digits do. break. end.
        position =. position+1
    end.
    whole =. position{.text
    if. -.1 6 width_digits whole do. failure '' return. end.
    rest =. position}.text

        rest =. }.rest
        position =. 0
        while. position<#rest do.
            if. -. (position{rest)e.Digits do. break. end.
            position =. position+1
        end.
        fraction =. position{.rest
        if. -.1 3 width_digits fraction do. failure '' return. end.
        rest =. position}.rest

    index =. ('';(,'b');'kb';'mb';'gb')i.<tolower rest

    factor =. index{1 1 1024 1048576 1073741824
    value =. factor*decimal whole

        value =. value+<.!.0 scaled%divisor
    end.
    success value
)

parse_host =: 3 : 0
    parts =. '.' split y
    if. *./y e.Digits,'.' do.
        if. 4~:#parts do. failure '' return. end.
        for_box. parts do.
            part =. >box

        if. (-.({.label)e.alnum)+.(-.({:label)e.alnum)+.-.*./label e.alnum,'-' do. failure '' return. end.
    end.

parse_date =: 3 : 0
